status: protocol fixed before any performance access; this file approves no model training/evaluation, no full-cohort processing

primary_exclusions.subject: sub-080
primary_exclusions.reason: n-back events 285 rows (expected 294; 9 rows short inside blocks)

task.name: nbk
task.condition_of_row: prefix of trial_type before the first underscore

windows.time_origin: first stored volume acquired at t=0 s; event onsets used as given; slice timing corrected to reference 0 s (3dTshift -tzero 0)
windows.B: first recorded onset of the condition
windows.window_rule: [s0 + 30k, s0 + 30(k+1)), k = 0..3; must satisfy s0 + 120 <= E - end_buffer
windows.volume_index_rule: first volume index = s0 / 2 + 15k; 15 consecutive volumes

features_spec_not_executed.fc: Pearson over the 15 frames, upper triangle 4,950, clip +-(1-1e-6), Fisher z; window demeaning only inside FC

model_spec_not_executed.scaler: per-feature mean/SD fitted on the training fold only; zero-variance training features dropped with the same mask applied to validation/test
model_spec_not_executed.convergence_failures: counted and reported per fold; not silently retried

evaluation_spec_not_executed.outer: 6 folds, leave-one-order-out: all persons, conditions, windows of one order held out
evaluation_spec_not_executed.inner: 5 folds, leave-one-order-out within the outer-training orders
evaluation_spec_not_executed.inner_score: per-person 3-block accuracy, averaged within order, orders equally weighted
evaluation_spec_not_executed.C_selection: max inner score; ties within 1e-12 -> smaller C
evaluation_spec_not_executed.refit: final C refit on all outer-training persons; test predicted once
evaluation_spec_not_executed.sample_weight: w(window) proportional to 1 / (n_order x 3 x m_person_condition); orders, persons within order, conditions within person, windows within condition equal
evaluation_spec_not_executed.aggregation: mean window probabilities within the condition block, argmax; ties broken 0 -> 1 -> 2
evaluation_spec_not_executed.secondary_window_metric: window-level accuracy averaged within person first
evaluation_spec_not_executed.primary_endpoint: per-person proportion of the 3 blocks correct (= macro recall)
evaluation_spec_not_executed.primary_estimand: Delta = fullTS - FC: mean over the 6 orders (equal weight) of within-order person means, paired by person
evaluation_spec_not_executed.ci: stratified (within order) paired person bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261017, percentile 95%
evaluation_spec_not_executed.delta_note: absolute accuracy 0.02; operational design threshold, not a clinically or cognitively validated threshold
evaluation_spec_not_executed.single_primary_comparison: fullTS - FC; mean and mean+SD baselines descriptive only
evaluation_spec_not_executed.position_confound_note: leave-one-order-out reduces but does not remove block-position effects; no claim of order-invariant load or stimulus generalisation

threads.OMP_NUM_THREADS_note: rev4: 4 from sub-002 on; sub-001 steps 01-02 ran with 2 under rev3

preprocessing.concurrency: one subject at a time, sequential

software.python_for_extraction: MoBSE .venv: nibabel 5.4.2, nilearn 0.13.1, numpy 2.4.3, scipy 1.17.1, matplotlib 3.10.8

template.equivalent: MNI152NLin2009cAsym (1 mm grid origin -96,-132,-78 identical to TemplateFlow res-01)

atlas.name: Schaefer2018 100 parcels 7 networks
atlas.not_used: Schaefer FSLMNI152 (= MNI152NLin6Asym) files in ~/nilearn_data; different template space

preprocessing.anat: sswarper2 -input T1w -base MNI152_2009_template_SSW.nii.gz -subid <sub> -odir <work>/anat (defaults: minp 11, unifize on, no deoblique)

func_afni_proc.tshift: 3dTshift -tzero 0 -tpattern @<SliceTiming from the subject's JSON, seconds> (afni_proc default interpolation)
func_afni_proc.align: -align_unifize_epi local; align_epi_anat.py -cost lpc+ZZ -giant_move -check_flip; anat = sswarper2 anatSS (no skull)
func_afni_proc.tlrc: -tlrc_base MNI152_2009_template_SSW.nii.gz -tlrc_NL_warp -tlrc_NL_warped_dsets anatQQ, aff12, WARP from sswarper2
func_afni_proc.html_review: none (APQC needs matplotlib/flask in AFNI python; not installed)

preprocessing.distortion_correction: none: no fieldmap or reverse phase-encoding EPI in the dataset; no synthetic or fieldmap-less correction applied (limitation)
preprocessing.roi_extraction: mean over voxels in (atlas ROI AND EPI full_mask) of the volreg output on the atlas grid
preprocessing.scaling: per-ROI percent signal change by run mean: 100 * (x / mean_t(x) - 1)

regressors: motion 6 (dfile_rall: roll, pitch, yaw, dS, dL, dP)
nuisance.fit: ordinary least squares over the full run (266 volumes) per subject; offline analysis that uses future time points

preprocessing.offline_limitation: run-wide slice timing, motion, registration, scaling and nuisance estimation use the whole 532 s run; results do not support a claim that 30 s of acquisition suffices

qc.Q1_inputs: T1w and n-back present and readable; sha256 equals download verification; TR 2 s; 266 volumes; events with 3 complete conditions (98 rows each); sub-080 excluded (R1)

Q2_motion.fd: Power FD, rotations in degrees converted to mm on a 50 mm sphere, from dfile_rall; FD_0 = 0

Q3_windows.flagged_volumes: {t-1, t, t+1} for each spike t
Q3_windows.window_excluded_if: any flagged volume inside the 15 window volumes

Q4_registration.pipeline: all steps rc = 0 and expected outputs present
Q4_registration.lr_flip: align_epi_anat -check_flip must not prefer the flipped EPI
visual_checklist: V2 anatQQ outline, ventricles and major sulci on the template without gross misalignment

V3 mean EPI in template space: brain edge and ventricles on the template without gross shift; expected susceptibility dropout (orbitofrontal / inferior temporal) noted, not counted as registration failure
V4 no cortical cut-off by the EPI slab beyond what coverage reports
descriptive_numbers: anatQQ vs template Pearson r inside template brain mask
mean EPI vs template Pearson r inside template brain mask (2 mm)
Dice(EPI full_mask, template brain mask at 2 mm)

Q5_roi.coverage: fraction of atlas ROI voxels inside EPI full_mask (2 mm atlas grid)
Q5_roi.interpretation: subject-level common exclusion (same subjects for all models); rule applied as written, not tuned on the pilot

qc.Q6_nuisance_masks: eroded WM and CSF masks non-empty and their series finite with variance > 0; voxel counts reported
Q7_descriptive_only: DVARS (RMS of backward-difference voxel PSC inside full_mask)
tSNR (mean / SD after linear detrend, median in full_mask and per ROI)
volume-0 to run-median global intensity ratio
qc.stop_rule: before training: stop and review if any order has n < 10 or more than 20% of the 157 candidates are excluded
qc.blinding: QC decided before and without any classification output; no classification is run in this protocol step

pilot.selection_rule: lowest subject ID within each of the 6 block orders (non-performance; fixed before preprocessing)
pilot.feasibility_success: pipeline rc = 0 and complete outputs for 6/6; QC computed for 6/6
pilot.full_processing_recommendation_rule: recommend full 157-subject processing (separate approval) only if feasibility succeeds and no systematic registration or coverage failure appears; otherwise report the failing step and stop
